name: Effy AI
description: Connect Effy AI to Claude to run your HR processes where you already work. Claude can launch and draft performance reviews and 360° feedback, prep and debrief your 1-1s, and turn what you learn into goals and growth plans for your team. Perfect for prepping your next 1-1 in minutes, writing reviews that don't sound generic, or coaching a manager through a difficult feedback conversation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Effy AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Effy AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://go.effy.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Effy AI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Effy AI lists 22 MCP tools, including ai_create_skill, ai_delete_skill, ai_get_skill, ai_lookup_skill, ai_search_skills, ai_update_skill, hr_create_activity, hr_create_employee, hr_delete_activity, hr_delete_employee, hr_get_activity, and hr_get_employee.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Effy AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Effy AI in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Effy AI MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Effy AI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Effy AI is developed by Effy AI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
